calls.prompt: Full-body orthographic front view of a Roman conscript foot soldier, a stocky young man with a plain unshaven face: a helmet with a brim, a ridge and hinged cheek guards; a short-sleeved mail shirt reaching mid-thigh with a plain trimmed neck and sleeve hems; a leather belt with a short sword in a plain scabbard hanging at his right hip; loose knee-length linen trousers; wrapped shins and simple leather sandals. A large curved rectangular shield with a round central boss hangs by a strap at his left side, its lower edge at knee height, held clear of his body and of his left arm. He stands in a neutral A-pose: arms straight, held out and angled about 35 degrees down away from the torso so they do not touch the body, the shield or the sword, open empty hands with fingers together, legs slightly apart, feet flat. The sword stays sheathed. No fire, no effects. He faces the camera directly, symmetrical, the whole figure from head to sandals visible with empty margin around it, centred on a plain flat light grey background, no scenery, no ground, a single character. Game-ready 3D character model reference for a modeller: simple large readable shapes, chunky proportions, big hands, matte surfaces, one flat colour per material with no pattern and no texture detail. Palette blocks: mail shirt dark steel grey, helmet lighter iron grey, shield face mid wood brown with the boss muted bronze, trousers and shin wraps warm linen beige, belt, sword scabbard and sandals mid brown leather, skin warm tan, hair dark brown. Soft even studio light, no cast shadows, no text, no labels, no grid, no watermark.
